# Task model, pinned copy

Copied from [geolonia/datamodels](https://github.com/geolonia/datamodels) at
commit 751b1f3 (`models/task/context.jsonld`, `models/task/Task/schema.json`,
and `models/common/Geometry/schema.json`, which the Task schema refers to),
published as https://datamodels.jp/context/task/v1.jsonld,
https://datamodels.jp/schema/task/Task/v1.json and
https://datamodels.jp/schema/common/Geometry/v1.0.0.json.

The tests check the bridge's Task entities against this copy, without
network. When the model changes on datamodels.jp, copy the files again.
